newsitem.title: QATAR: U.S.-Qatar navies end joint military exercises.
newsitem.headline: U.S.-Qatar navies end joint military exercises.

text.p: The navies of Qatar and the United States on Tuesday ended joint military exercises code-named "Eastern Maverick 97", the official Qatar News Agency said.
A Qatari infantry battalion and several helicopters took part in the wargames which began on Sunday, the agency added. It gave no further details.
Diplomats said the U.S. warship "Essex" participated in the exercise, held under a defence pact with Washington.
The U.S. military is currently storing equipment for an army brigade in Qatar in case it is needed by U.S. troops in the region in a new Gulf emergency.
Qatar was an ally in the U.S.-led military coalition that defeated Iraq in the 1991 Gulf War.
